'''Gon-Sa''' was a [[Voss (species)|Voss]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a diplomat. He attended a meeting at which Republic [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Evran]] and [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Torius]] were trying to convince the Voss to join their respective sides for protection. The Voss however had no need for protection - the mystic foresaw all threats, like when Mystic [[Ki-Ve]] saw that Torius planned to detonate a [[ZR-57 orbital strike bomb]] at [[Voss-Ka]]. The Voss knew that he would be stopped by [[Havoc Squad]] [[Major/Legends|Major]] and did not interfere until the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] was dead, after which they revealed all they knew and asked the Republic to give them the bomb for study.
